en: Proverbs 12

p.src: 1  Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

en: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
u.src: 1  Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

p.src: 2  A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

ja: から好意を得るが、 主は
en: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
u.src: 2  A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

p.src: 3  A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

ja: つことはできないが、 義
en: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
u.src: 3  A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

p.src: 4  A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

en: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
u.src: 4  A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

p.src: 5  The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

ja: だが、 悪しき者の助言は
en: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
u.src: 5  The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

p.src: 6  The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

en: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
u.src: 6  The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

p.src: 7  The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

ja: しき者は覆されて、いなくなるが、 義
en: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
u.src: 7  The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

p.src: 8  A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

ja: じて称賛されるが、 心のねじれた者は侮られる。
en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
u.src: 8  A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

p.src: 9  Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

ja: んじられていても、しもべを
en: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.
u.src: 9  Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

p.src: 10  A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

ja: を気遣うが、 悪しき者のあわれみさえ
en: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
u.src: 10  A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

p.src: 11  He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

ja: りるが、 むなしいものを
en: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
u.src: 11  He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

p.src: 12  The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

en: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
u.src: 12  The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

p.src: 13  An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

ja: の罪によってわなにかかるが、 義
en: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
u.src: 13  An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

p.src: 14  A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
u.src: 14  A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

p.src: 15  The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

ja: しいが、 知恵のある者は助言に
en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
u.src: 15  The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

p.src: 16  A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

ja: はその日のうちに苛立ちを表すが、 慎重な者は侮
en: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
u.src: 16  A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

p.src: 17  He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

en: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
u.src: 17  He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

p.src: 18  There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

en: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
u.src: 18  There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

p.src: 19  Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

ja: つが、 偽りの舌は一瞬しか続かない。
en: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
u.src: 19  Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

p.src: 20  Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

en: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
u.src: 20  Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

p.src: 21  No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

ja: いも降りかからないが、 悪しき者は
en: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
u.src: 21  No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

p.src: 22  Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

en: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.
u.src: 22  Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

p.src: 23  A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

en: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
u.src: 23  A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

p.src: 24  The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

en: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
u.src: 24  The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

p.src: 25  Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

en: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
u.src: 25  Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

p.src: 26  A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

ja: は友を慎重に選ぶが、 悪しき者の
en: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
u.src: 26  A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

p.src: 27  The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

en: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
u.src: 27  The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

p.src: 28  In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

en: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
u.src: 28  In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
